claims.text: n8n is licensed under the Sustainable Use License, not MIT. Use is limited to the licensor's internal business purposes or non-commercial/personal use, and distribution or provision to others must be free of charge and non-commercial.

Offering a paid SaaS that hosts n8n for customers, or embeds it so customers drive it, falls outside the Sustainable Use License grant. The product must instead call a n8n instance the customer operates under their own licence, or be sold under a separate OEM agreement.
Whether a customer on n8n Cloud who connects to our product via webhook counts as the licensor 'providing n8n to others' is not resolved. Needs a legal opinion.
The cloned n8n docs contain 1,348 markdown pages, 9,578 chunks and 688,466 words across 11 domains, plus 12 importable workflow JSON files.

The documentation is generated from github.com/n8n-io/n8n-docs, a GitBook space. Cloning that repo gives markdown source rather than scraped HTML, and n8n also publishes a machine-readable corpus at docs.n8n.io/llms-full.txt and an index at docs.n8n.io/llms.txt.

forge.py ask ranks chunks by inverse document frequency with word-boundary matching. An earlier substring-count implementation returned irrelevant results for the query 'how do I paginate API results', scoring a deployment page above the HTTP Request pagination section.

The n8n OEM / Embed agreement reportedly costs approximately $50,000 per year. This figure comes from third-party sources (Activepieces blog, community forum), not from n8n's own pricing page, and is unconfirmed.

Given the Sustainable Use License constraint, the product architecture is: the customer operates their own n8n instance; our SaaS is a dashboard that calls the n8n REST API with the customer's credentials. We never host, embed, or redistribute n8n.

Multi-tenant n8n patterns are documented in the community: Siennabase (boilerplate for running n8n across many client instances), dynamic credential management via the n8n REST API (five.co, wednesday.is), and per-tenant workflow import via POST /api/v1/workflows.

The n8n public REST API supports: workflow CRUD (GET/POST/PUT/DELETE /api/v1/workflows), execution management (GET /api/v1/executions with filters), credential creation (POST /api/v1/credentials), and webhook triggering. Authentication is via API key created in Settings > n8n API.

Semantic/vector retrieval is not available. The wiki is queryable through SQLite FTS5 and the JSON indexes only; the Qdrant pipeline in saas-factory/analyzer requires OPENAI_API_KEY and a running Qdrant instance.
